specialty_focus: MediSupplies Ltd is a UK-based medical distributor supplying specialist medical equipment, everyday clinical consumables, and pharmaceuticals to healthcare providers, clinics, GP surgeries, care homes, and private consumers. It operates under an MHRA-approved wholesale license for regulated pharmaceuticals and distributes products from prominent healthcare brands rather than manufacturing them.
